verdict.rationale: Reflect's docs show #tags on notes: search can filter by #tags, and Kindle sync auto-tags imported notes as #book, so tag-based organization and retrieval is supported. Nothing in the evidence shows typed properties or metadata fields on notes, so only the tag half of the story is delivered, and even that is thinly documented. Missing for 10: typed properties/metadata fields on notes, documentation of tag management (renaming, hierarchy, consistency), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
